findings.detail: The source SOI rows and schedule totals carry fair value, but the check reports only 108 of 216 leaves with fair_value.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate completeness issue. The raw SOI has explicit Fair Value columns on investment rows and schedule totals tying current-period investments to fair value 523,092,809; the comparative schedule also has fair value totals. A 50.0% fair_value completeness result therefore reflects an extraction/completeness gap rather than missing source disclosure.
